question.name: The Dolphins' Strange Gift
question.text: A villager finds a smooth, oddly shaped object washed ashore after dolphins were seen playing offshore.

a1.text: It is an unusual shell. The researchers document it.

a2.text: It is an ordinary stone polished by waves, but the children treasure it anyway.

a3.text: A skilled craftsperson turns it into a charming ornament.

b1.text: A dolphin surfaces nearby; the children insist it has come to say thank you.

b2.text: The object washes ashore again the next day, starting a village joke.

b3.text: The villagers hold a small celebration of the sea's mysteries.
